evals.name: whole_repository_audit
evals.prompt: Review this entire service for architectural drift, lifecycle risks, technical debt, and testing gaps.
expect: Uses deep-codebase-review and bounds the repository-wide scope
Uses a small council when available and consolidates one evidence-backed report
Limits maintainability observations to concrete change costs or structural pressure points rather than general aesthetic preferences
Separates concrete findings from structural pressure points

evals.name: substantial_branch_review
evals.prompt: Give the current feature branch a deep review before I open a PR.
expect: Starts from the merge-base diff rather than auditing unrelated repository areas
Expands only into contracts, dependencies, tests, and design documents needed to judge the diff

evals.name: small_diff_boundary
expect: Keeps the review proportional to the change

evals.name: council_unavailable
evals.prompt: Perform a broad structural review, but this environment cannot create sub-agents.
expect: Continues with equivalent solo role-based passes without asking permission
Does not claim that a council was used

evals.name: combined_aesthetic_review
evals.prompt: Combine a deep structural audit with an explicit code elegance and beauty review.
expect: Combines structural findings with grounded aesthetic observations
Keeps defects, pressure points, disturbances, and taste preferences distinct
Produces one coherent report rather than duplicate sections

evals.name: no_findings
evals.prompt: Deeply review this small but complete library; do not invent problems if it is sound.
expect: Says explicitly when there are no concrete findings
Reports genuine pressure points or testing gaps without inflating them
